text:
jess_sales: FYI starting Orion Analytics POC thread. They want quick hosted keys to demo, but also asked for Dedicated pool pricing and a VPC path if we progress. POC length: 45 days. Request: billing project with $12,000 spend cap target + $3,000 in trial credits. Can legal/finance/security confirm what's doable?

ara_solutions: Hi @jess_sales — hosted + credits straightforward. Dedicated and VPC require capacity lead time + security intake. For billing project I need billing contact email and whether they want monthly invoices.

hannah_finops: On caps: we can't currently hard-stop hosted requests automatically; we set token quotas and alerts. We can apply a policy that rate-limits new keys aggressively at threshold. For Dedicated we can map spend to the commit and track usage. If customer insists on absolute shutdown on overage, ops can manually disable the project.

nate_runtime: Dedicated ETA depends on region and model family. Typical 2	6 weeks if GPUs are available. For a fast POC we can bump hosted quotas and add autoscaling — but that won't have commit-backed throughput. If Orion needs predictable latency, Dedicated is the route.

jess_sales: Orion preferred region is europe-west1. They want ephemeral keys for sandboxing (short TTL) and a separate CI service key. Can we do 8h TTLs?

ara_solutions: Yep. We support arbitrary TTLs down to 1h. I'll prepare an ephemeral key mint script and a short guide showing how to rotate keys in CI.

nate_runtime: Example internal command (redwoodctl):
```
redwoodctl keys create --project orion-poc --ttl 8h --scopes gen,embeds --rate 50r/s
```
It returns a one-time token. CI key suggestion: create a long-lived key scoped to embeddings only.

hannah_finops: Credits: can apply $3k promo credit to the proj. For the spend cap please confirm whether "cap" means a token quota or a request for ops to enforce a hard stop. Also provide company billing email + PO if they want invoices.

sec_bot: Security checklist: for VPC/private need customer CIDR, allowed egress IPs, contact for firewall coords, and signed DPA. If Orion needs our on-prem bundle, that'll trigger full intake (SOC2 proof required). Expect security turnaround 3-7 business days after docs received.

ops_runner: If you want a strict off-switch we can add a manual runbook: ops will disable project keys when requested. We can automate with a ticket that executes a block action, but it requires an ops owner and a change window to avoid accidental kills.

ara_solutions: Minimal recommended flow to get them going today:
- create billing proj `orion-poc` and apply $3k credit
- set token quota to approximate $12k spend for 45 days
- mint ephemeral keys (8h) + CI key guidance
- wire alerts to orion-eng@ and our CS lead
- open capacity request for europe-west1 Dedicated + security intake for VPC in parallel

jess_sales: I'll DM billing contact (finance@orionanalytics.com) and confirm PO. Can someone prep an onboarding note that clearly states the soft cap behavior? Want to avoid confusion.

hannah_finops: I'll create billing record and flag project as POC. Draft onboarding note: "This project has trial credits applied and a token quota approximating $12,000 of usage for the POC. The quota will trigger alerts to both Orion and Redwood. If you require an absolute stop, contact support@redwood.com and ops can disable project keys."

nate_runtime: I've opened capacity request REQ-4999 for europe-west1 (models: LlamaX-24B quantized). ETA 14-18 business days pending capacity.

sec_bot: Security intake ticket SEC-1102 created. Sent questionnaire to jess_sales.

deploy-bot: Job queued: create-billing-project/orion-poc 12s. Requested by hannah_finops.

hannah_finops: Billing project created: orion-poc. Project ID rwd-or-00456. Applied $3k credit. Please verify quotas and keys.

ara_solutions: Minted ephemeral key (masked): sk_test_****abcd TTL 8h. Token quota set to $12k equivalent for 45 days. Alerts configured (orion-eng@ and cs@).

ops_runner: Reminder: open #eng-oncall task if you want automated kill runbook. We can script it within 48h once owner assigned.

jess_sales: Sent billing contact + PO via DM. Also sent DPA to Orion legal. Thanks all — I'll update once DPA signed. :white_check_mark:
